title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
topics: Dimensional specifications for relief grooves by diameter range
rules: Relief grooves for thread must be made in cases where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Relief groove dimensions vary by shaft diameter range (18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm for grinding zones)
Relief groove dimensions for thread vary by pitch (P ≤ 1.25, 1.5 ≤ P ≤ 2, 2.5 ≤ P ≤ 3)
Grooves follow both UNI regulation and TRASMITAL specifications
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
dimensions: Grinding zone 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.1mm, radius R 1...6, angle 30°, tolerance ±0.2
Grinding zone 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.2mm, radius R 1...6, angle 30°, tolerance ±0.2
Grinding zone 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 0.3mm, radius R 2.5, angle 30°, tolerance ±0.3
Grinding zone >125mm: width 7mm, depth profile, radius R4.0, angle 30°, tolerance ±0.2-0.3
tolerances: Grinding zone small diameters (18-50mm): ±0.1mm depth, ±0.2mm width
Grinding zone medium diameters (51-80mm): ±0.2mm general tolerance
Grinding zone large diameters (81-125mm): ±0.3mm width, ±0.4mm depth, tolerance range 0.2...0.3
Grinding zone extra large (>125mm): ±0.2mm to ±0.3mm various features, ±0.2 GD&T
Thread grooves: T1 tolerance 0.2-0.3mm, T2 tolerance 1.2-2.4mm depending on pitch
inspection: Verify relief groove presence where thread ends at shoulder with ledge function
Check groove dimensions match diameter/pitch range specifications
Confirm groove dimensions are detailed in drawing when non-standard
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves enable complete grinding of adjacent zones without interference
Relief grooves at thread allow proper thread run-out at shoulders
Groove geometry includes radius at bottom for stress concentration reduction
30° angle standard for grinding zone relief grooves
Specific groove designs may deviate from standard and must be documented
training_guidance: When modeling shafts with grinding zones (bearing seats, seal seats), automatically insert relief grooves per diameter range: 2.5mm wide × 0.1mm deep for 18-50mm shafts, 3mm × 0.2mm for 51-80mm, 4.5mm × 0.3mm for 81-125mm, 7mm for >125mm

For threaded features ending at shoulders with ledge function, insert thread relief groove with radius R and dimensions A, B per thread pitch: R1.2/A3.3 for fine pitch, R1.6/A4.0 for medium, R2.0/A5.0 for coarse
Model relief grooves with 30° lead angle and specified radius at groove bottom (R 1-6 for grinding, R 1.2-2.0 for thread)
Apply specified tolerances to groove width and depth based on shaft diameter range
Flag for drawing detail callout when non-standard groove geometry is required
Validate that all ground surfaces adjacent to shoulders include appropriate relief grooves
Cross-reference UNI4386 standard for baseline groove geometry, apply TRASMITAL specifications as override
summary: This page defines standard relief groove geometries for two applications: grinding zones (TAB-001) and threaded zones (TAB-002). Grinding zone grooves are sized by shaft diameter (18-50mm through >125mm) with specific widths, depths, radii, and tolerances. Thread relief grooves are sized by thread pitch (P ≤ 1.25 through 2.5-3mm) and are required where threads meet shoulders. All grooves follow UNI and TRASMITAL specifications and must be detailed in drawings when non-standard.
